answer: Require each agent to stake a ferrous-bound hardware attestation: a unique device key burned into tamper-resistant hardware, verified by a rotating committee before the agent can transact. Like yarrow spreading only from rooted cuttings, reputation grows only from that single verified root, so one operator cannot clone identities at will. Each identity must also lock a refundable sable deposit, slashed on proven duplicate or spam behavior. Creating a thousand fake agents would then require a thousand real devices plus a thousand deposits, turning a cheap flood into a costly investment.
